summary: Selling deepened a bit an hour in: the Dow is down roughly 400+ points (~0.9%) with Home Depot the biggest drag and the Nasdaq sliding ahead of Nvidia's report after the close; bias stays puts. Changed since 07:20: HD put 55->57 and QQQ put 50->52 on the broader weakness; other picks and all levels held (quote pages blocked, prices are estimates).

picks.name: Intel
picks.reason: Down ~2.6% premarket near 54 after Nvidia's 13F showed a 25% stake cut, on top of Monday's 7% drop and a shareholder suit; under 53 extends, back over Monday's ~55.5 close fails.

picks.name: Home Depot
picks.reason: Q3 sales beat but traffic fell, comp guide trimmed and CEO Decker steps down; now the Dow's biggest drag as the index falls ~400 pts; under 336 extends, reclaiming the ~346 close fails.

picks.name: Walt Disney
picks.reason: FQ4 beat, dividend up 33% to $2, $9B buyback, but the early pop faded to about -1%; needs to reclaim 123 to trend, under 118.5 fails.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq sliding into Nvidia's report after Monday's 2.5% drop and new chip export controls; under 654 resumes the sell-off, over 665 negates.

picks.name: Take-Two Interactive
picks.reason: GTA VI launches Thursday with presales ahead of forecasts and Jefferies at $300, but Monday's gap faded; a push through the ~237.4 high extends, under 228 fails (price is an estimate).

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Closed 156.14, lowest in over a year, and is roughly flat to +1% premarket before tonight's first report since Huang's exit; a pre-earnings relief bid over 158.5 extends, under 153 the sell-off resumes.
